__broaden__.ἧς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; fem. gen. sg.: ’whose’ (ἧς εἵνεκα ’for whose sake’) · also ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with its noun (ἧς ἀλόχοιο ’his own wife’) · also relative, fem. gen. sg., attracted into the case of its antecedent: ’which’ (τῆς … γενεῆς ἧς ’the breed which’) · also relative, fem. gen. sg., object of ἐέλδομαι: ’for whom (I long)’
__broaden__.κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · with αἴ + subj.: ’if perhaps’ · with a relative + fut. indic.: ’who will, in that event’ · also εἰς ὅ κέ + fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κέ σ’ … ποιήσεται ’until he makes you’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’will’ (καί κέ τις … ἐρέει ’someone will say’) · also ὄφρά κέ + subj.: ’until’ (… κέ … ἐνείκω ’until I bring’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so … might’ · also with an aor. indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κέ τοι … φάνη ’there would have appeared to you’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (οὐδέ κέ τίς … ἀτιμήσειε ’no one would dishonour’) · also εἴ κέ in an indirect question, + fut. indic. or short-vowel subj.: ’whether’ (εἴ κέ … ἀπώσεται ’whether he will thrust back’) · also εἰ … κέ + short-vowel subj. in a condition: ’if … should’ (εἰ … κέ σε … ἀπολύσομεν ’if we should release you’) · also εἰς ὅ κέ + long-vowel subj.: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κέ … ἕληται ’until he takes’) · also + short-vowel subj. in a main clause: ’shall’ (ἐγὼ δέ κέ τοι ἰδέω χάριν ’I shall acknowledge the favour’)
__broaden__.κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); with the opt., potential: ’might, would’; with the subj. in conditions after εἰ, αἰ · also + subj. or fut. indic. in a main or relative clause: ’shall’ (’I shall take’; ’to whom I come’) · also + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὅττί κεν εἴπῃς) · also with a past indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κεν … ἐτύχθη) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would be’ (κεν … κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would be better’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after εἰς ὅ: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … μάχωνται ’until they fight’) · also εἴ κεν + opt., in a condition: ’if … should’ · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that … may’ · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὅτε: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … ἵκωμαι ’whenever I come’) · also ἤ κεν + subj., in an indirect alternative question: ’whether … or’ · also ὅππως κεν + subj., in an indirect question: ’how … may’ · also ὄφρά κεν + subj., purpose: ’so that … may’ (ὄφρά κεν ἔλθητον ’so that you two may come’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὄφρ’ ἂν: ’as long as’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … κεν ὁρᾷ ’as long as he sees’) · also ἐπεί κεν + fut. indic., in a temporal clause: ’as soon as’ (ἐπεί κεν … παραλέξομαι ’as soon as I shall lie beside’)
